text:
maria: FYI staging canary publish just got halted by deploybot — provenance mismatch on manifest list, looks like a partial manifest landed in eu-ecr
raj: ugh, saw that. deploybot logs show `manifestlist contains 2 entries but only 1 blob present` during validation
oliver: can you paste the deploybot excerpt?
maria: sure — from deploybot: ```ERROR: publish failed: manifestlist validation error: platform entry missing layer: linux/arm64 at index 1; found metadata-overlay:buildid=abcd1234 but missing blob digest```
sarah: if a platform entry is missing that will fail provenance attestation for the manifestlist — publishbot should fall back to per-arch pushes but it looks like the mirror created a manifestlist before all blobs finished
raj: this smells like a race between the mirror job and the manifestlist assembly. mirror logs show the arm64 chunk uploaded ~20s later than amd64 and manifestlist assembled earlier
deploybot: automatic action: canary publish blocked, image flagged as "partial-manifest". Suggest pinning to last-good digest for canary route. :warning:
maria: recommendation: hold the release window for 30m, pin canary to `sha256:prevgood...` and schedule a manual republish of the full manifestlist after we confirm all blobs present
oliver: agree. Also we should avoid retagging the existing digest. Manual republish should generate deterministic manifestlist ordering and run provenance attestation locally before pushing
sarah: quick mitigation: add a temporary check in publish pipeline to wait for all chunk uploads for each platform before manifestlist finalization (small sleep + existence check). I'll draft a checklist
raj: for now I'll pin the canary traffic as requested. @maria can you call out the change in release notes? we'll add note about canary hold and follow-up republish
maria: on it — will add a brief entry and the rollback criteria if republish fails. Also i'm opening a short incident doc in #incidents with build ids
deploybot: note: if manual republish succeeds, deploybot will attempt automatic promote; will require explicit override to force promote earlier
oliver: long term: let's add a pre-assemble manifest verification step in publishbot to query `aws ecr batch-get-image` for all referenced digests and fail fast if any are missing
sarah: added to eng-releases backlog ticket #RELEASES-421 (will link) :white_check_mark:
maria: decision: hold canary -> pin to previous digest, manual republish off CI after mirror job fix, re-run provenance attestation, if attestation passes we proceed with canary promote. If republish fails we'll rollback to previous release and open a postmortem. Agreed?
raj: agreed. tagging owners: @sarah for pipeline fix, @oliver for republish/attestation, @maria for release notes & incident doc
sarah: working on a short patch, ETA 2h.
maria: thanks all. keeping this thread as the single source for the timeline. :memo:
